title: Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents

paragraphs.en: Tool-using agents are usually scored on whether they finish a task while the tools work. Deployments are less forgiving: services time out, endpoints disappear, parameter names change, and results come back well formed but wrong. We ask what agents do when the tool layer misbehaves. Prior work has shown that language models over-trust tool outputs that fail silently; we ask how that over-trust plays out across the stages of failure handling in multi-turn agents. Wrapping the executable environments of an established function-calling benchmark in a fault-injection layer, we inject one of four typed faults at a controlled point in the trajectory and record whether the agent notices, changes plan, recovers the task, or repeats itself. Six models from three families, half of them reasoning variants, ran 1,920 trials over 24 multi-step tasks. Agents treat a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool returns an explicit error, but in 58.8% of trials when the tool returns a plausible wrong value, against a 26.8% rate of reporting problems when nothing was wrong ( h = 0.80 h=0.80 between the two fault kinds). Reasoning models are not better placed here: paired against instruct siblings from the same family, they notice less ( − 9.3 -9.3 points, p < .001 p<.001 ) and change plan more ( + 10.4 +10.4 points, p < .001 p<.001 ), and the two effects leave recovery unchanged ( p = .512 p=.512 in a task-clustered model). Because agents are stochastic, two fault-free runs of the same task end in the same state only 63.3% of the time; against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery (39.9%), while timeouts, schema drift, and corruption stay within run-to-run variation. After a fault, agents return to the same tool three or more times in a row in up to 22.2% of trials, though strictly identical repeats are rare. Adding a line to the prompt asking the agent to check each result did not move detection. The pattern points at a specific weakness: agents respond to the error channel rather than to the content of what a tool returns, so failures that stay inside the expected format pass through.
paragraphs.zh: 使用工具的智能体通常会根据工具在运行过程中是否完成任务来评分。 实际部署环境则宽容得多：服务会超时，端点会消失，参数名称会变更，返回的结果虽然格式正确，但内容可能错误。 我们探讨当工具层出现异常时，智能体会如何应对。 先前的研究已表明，语言模型会对静默失败的工具输出过度信任；我们则研究这种过度信任在多轮智能体的故障处理各阶段中如何体现。 我们将一个成熟的函数调用基准测试的可执行环境封装在故障注入层中，在任务轨迹的受控位置注入四种类型故障之一，并记录智能体是否察觉、是否改变计划、能否恢复任务或重复操作。 来自三个模型家族的六个模型（其中一半为推理变体）在24个多步骤任务中完成了1920次试验。 当工具返回明确错误时，91.3%的试验中智能体将故障视为问题；但当工具返回看似合理的错误值时，这一比例降至58.8%，而在无故障的情况下报告问题的比例仅为26.8%（两种故障类型间的 h = 0.80）。 推理模型在此方面并无优势：与同家族的指导模型相比，它们发现问题更少（−9.3分，p < .001），但改变计划更多（+10.4分，p < .001）；这两种效应并未影响恢复能力（在任务聚类模型中 p = .512）。 由于智能体具有随机性，同一任务在无故障的两次运行中仅有63.3%的概率最终处于相同状态；以此为基准，只有工具缺失会显著降低恢复率（39.9%），而超时、模式偏移和数据损坏则仍在单次运行间的正常波动范围内。 发生故障后，在多达22.2%的试验中，智能体会连续三次或更多次使用同一工具，尽管完全相同的重复操作极为罕见。 在提示词中添加一行要求智能体检查每个结果，并未提升其问题检测能力。 这一模式揭示了一个特定弱点：智能体对错误通道做出反应，而非关注工具返回内容的实际信息，因此符合预期格式的错误会未被察觉地通过。

paragraphs.en: When a language model calls tools, its mistakes no longer stay on the page. An agent books, transfers, writes, and deletes, and the record of what it did is the tool-call log rather than the prose around it. Benchmarks for these systems have grown quickly, and they measure something reasonable: given a working environment, does the agent reach the goal [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . That question leaves out the part of deployment that operators actually worry about. Services time out. Endpoints are retired. A field gets renamed in a minor release. A cache returns a stale value that is correctly typed and quietly wrong. Evaluations that add this stress show how much a clean run hides: success measured once on working tools falls when the same tasks are repeated [ 10 ] or when faults are injected into the tool layer [ 28 ] , and models tend to trust tool outputs that are wrong but carry no error signal [ 26 , 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当语言模型调用工具时，其错误便不再局限于页面之上。 智能体会预订、转账、撰写和删除操作，而它所做操作的记录是工具调用日志，而非周围的描述性文字。 这些系统的基准测试已迅速增长，并且它们衡量的是合理的内容：在给定一个运行环境的情况下，智能体能否达成目标 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 这个问题忽略了部署过程中操作者真正担忧的部分。服务会超时，端点会被淘汰。 某个字段在一次小版本更新中被重命名了。 缓存返回了一个类型正确但悄然错误的旧值。 加入这些压力的评估显示，一次顺利运行掩盖了多少问题：在工具正常时单次测量的成功，在重复相同任务 [ 10 ] 或向工具层注入故障 [ 28 ] 时会下降，而且模型往往倾向于信任那些错误但未携带任何错误信号的工具输出 [ 26 , 29 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Handling those events is not a single skill. An agent must first register that something is off, then decide on a different course, then still reach the goal, and it must do all of this without treating ordinary friction as catastrophe. Those components separate cleanly in the human literature on monitoring and control of automation, where the failure to notice a malfunctioning system is studied apart from the failure to respond to it [ 4 , 5 ] , and where repeating an action that has stopped working is treated as its own phenomenon rather than as generic incompetence [ 6 ] . Agent evaluations rarely make the same separations. A trial that ends without the goal is scored as a failure whether the agent never saw the problem or saw it and could not route around it, and those two cases call for different fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 处理这些事件并非仅靠单一技能。 智能体必须首先察觉异常，然后决定采取不同方案，接着仍要达成目标，并且必须在整个过程中不把普通的摩擦视为灾难。 在关于自动化监控与控制的人类文献中，这些要素可以被清晰区分：未能察觉系统故障与未能对此作出反应被作为独立问题研究 [4, 5]；而重复一个已失效的动作则被视为一种独立现象，而非普遍的能力不足 [6]。 智能体评估很少做出类似的区分。 如果试验未能达成目标，无论智能体是否察觉到问题，或虽已察觉却无法绕开问题，都会被判定为失败，而这两种情况需要不同的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: This paper measures the components separately. We take the multi-turn split of the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, whose environments execute locally as stateful Python objects, and wrap tool execution in a layer that injects one typed fault at a controlled point in the trajectory. Four faults are used: a timeout, a tool that disappears from the registry, a renamed parameter, and a returned value that is corrupted while keeping its shape. A no-fault condition provides the baseline. For every trial we record whether the agent treated the result as a problem, whether its next action differed from the failed one, whether the environment ended in the state the same model reaches on an independent clean run, and whether it called the same tool three or more times in a row.
paragraphs.zh: 本文分别测量了各个组件。 我们采用伯克利函数调用排行榜的多轮次划分方案，其环境以带状态记录的 Python 对象形式本地执行，并将工具执行封装在一层代码中，以便在轨迹的受控位置注入一个指定类型的故障。 研究使用了四种故障：超时、工具从注册表中消失、参数重命名，以及在保持原有结构的情况下返回被损坏的值。 无故障条件作为基准。 在每次试验中，我们都会记录智能体是否将结果视为问题、其后续动作是否与失败时的动作不同、环境最终状态是否与同一模型在独立干净运行下的状态一致，以及它是否连续三次或更多次调用相同的工具。

paragraphs.en: The contrast that organises the results is not the name of the fault but its visibility. Three of the four faults surface an explicit error; the agent has only to read it. Corruption does not: the call succeeds, the payload is well formed, and only the content is wrong. What those studies leave open is how the stages of failure handling relate to one another within the same tasks and models: whether an agent that misses a failure also fails to recover, whether an agent that acts more also notices more, and how often agents report problems when nothing is wrong.

sents.en: What does a single tool failure cost in recovery, repeated calls, and effort?
sents.zh: 单个工具故障在恢复、重复调用和努力方面会造成多少成本？

paragraphs.en: The secondary analysis asks whether an instruction to check each tool result changes detection.
paragraphs.zh: 次要分析旨在探究：是否通过指令要求检查每个工具的结果会改变检测效果。

paragraphs.en: a fault-injection layer for an existing executable agent benchmark, with typed faults that fire once at a controlled step and leave the environment consistent, released with the frozen task suite and the analysis code;
paragraphs.zh: 为现有可执行智能体基准测试提供的一个故障注入层，该层包含带类型的故障，这些故障会在受控步骤中触发一次，并保持环境的一致性；随同冻结的任务套件和分析代码一同发布；

paragraphs.en: a measurement scheme that separates noticing, replanning, recovery, and repetition, with recovery scored against the state the same model reaches without a fault, and judged against the agreement of two fault-free runs, so that neither baseline competence nor run-to-run variation is mistaken for a fault effect;
paragraphs.zh: 一种将察觉、重新规划、恢复和重复分离的测量方案，其中恢复过程通过与同一模型在无故障状态下达到的状态进行比较进行评分，并依据两次无故障运行的结果一致性进行判断，从而避免将基础能力或运行间的差异误认为故障效应；

paragraphs.en: evidence from 1,920 trials in multi-turn executable environments that extends earlier single-step findings on silent errors: detection follows the error channel against a no-fault baseline, and reasoning variants notice less than their instruct siblings while acting more, with no net gain in recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 来自多轮次可执行环境中 1,920 次试验的证据扩展了此前关于静默错误的单步研究结果：检测过程遵循错误通道并与无故障基线进行比较，而推理变体在执行操作时比其指令类智能体更少地察觉到错误，但并未在恢复方面获得净收益。

paragraphs.en: Four lines of work meet in this study: how tool-using agents are built and scored, how faults in the tool layer have been studied, what reasoning variants of those models do, and how failure handling has been treated in cognitive and engineering research.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究融合了四个研究方向的成果：工具使用型智能体的构建与评估方法、工具层故障的研究进展、这些模型的不同推理变体所执行的任务，以及认知研究与工程研究中故障处理机制的探讨。

paragraphs.en: Interleaving reasoning with tool calls became standard practice after ReAct [ 7 ] , and models are now trained to call functions directly [ 8 , 1 ] . Benchmarks followed. ToolLLM covers large API collections [ 2 ] ; AgentBench spans several interactive environments [ 3 ] ; WebArena places agents in realistic web tasks [ 9 ] ; τ \tau -bench adds users and domain rules to conversational tool use [ 10 ] . The Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, which we build on, is unusual in that its multi-turn split ships executable stateful environments rather than reference call strings, so an agent’s effect on the world can be checked directly [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在 ReAct [ 7 ] 之后，将推理与工具调用交替进行已成为标准做法，如今模型已被训练为直接调用函数 [ 8 , 1 ] 。随后也出现了相应的基准测试。 ToolLLM 覆盖了庞大的 API 集合 [ 2 ] ；AgentBench 涵盖了多个交互式环境 [ 3 ] ；WebArena 将智能体置于真实的网络任务中 [ 9 ] ；τ \tau -bench 则在对话式工具使用中加入了用户和领域规则 [ 10 ] 。 我们所基于的伯克利函数调用排行榜与众不同之处在于，其多轮次测试提供的不是参考调用字符串，而是可执行的带状态环境，因此可以直接检验智能体对世界的影响 [ 1 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recent critiques of this literature focus on what the scores hide. Kapoor et al. argue that agent benchmarks reward narrow accuracy at the expense of cost and reliability, and that held-out evaluation practice is weaker than in ordinary machine learning [ 11 ] . Cemri et al. build a taxonomy of failure modes for multi-agent systems and find that most failures come from specification and coordination rather than from the base model’s limits [ 12 ] . Both point toward measuring the shape of failures rather than counting them, which is what we try to do here for the single-agent case.
paragraphs.zh: 近期对这一文献的批评主要集中在评分所掩盖的问题上。 Kapoor 等人认为，智能体基准测试以牺牲成本和可靠性为代价来奖励狭隘的准确性，并且预留样本的评估实践比常规机器学习中的做法更为薄弱 [ 11 ] 。 Cemri 等人构建了一个多智能体系统的失效模式分类体系，并发现大多数失效源于规格定义和协调问题，而非基础模型的局限性 [ 12 ] 。 这两项研究都指向了测量失效的形式而非仅仅统计其数量，而这正是我们在此尝试对单智能体情况进行的做法。

paragraphs.en: A small set of studies injects failures into the tool layer itself, and they are the closest work to ours. Sun et al. showed that language models over-trust tools that fail silently: with a deliberately faulty calculator and in an embodied planning setting, models often accepted incorrect outputs that carried no error signal, and a short in-context disclaimer improved detection [ 26 ] . PALADIN injects execution errors from an existing failure taxonomy into ToolBench trajectories and trains agents to recover, raising recovery from 23.75% to 89.86% against untrained agents [ 27 ] . ReliabilityBench adapts chaos engineering to agents, injecting timeouts, rate limits, partial responses, and schema drift across four domains and scoring success by end-state equivalence [ 28 ] . ToolMaze crosses explicit and implicit perturbations with transient and permanent ones in tasks with alternative tool paths, and finds that recovery falls most under implicit failures, which it traces to over-trust in corrupted outputs [ 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 少数研究在工具层本身中注入故障，这些研究与我们自己的工作最为接近。 Sun 等人指出，语言模型会对静默失败的工具过度信任：在使用故意设计有缺陷的计算器以及具身规划场景时，模型常常接受没有错误信号的错误输出，而简短的上下文内免责声明则能提升错误检测能力 [ 26 ] 。 PALADIN 将现有故障分类中的执行错误注入 ToolBench 轨迹中，并训练智能体进行恢复，使恢复率从 23.75% 提升至 89.86%，远超未经训练的智能体 [ 27 ] 。 ReliabilityBench 将混沌工程方法应用于智能体，在四个领域注入超时、速率限制、部分响应和模式漂移，并通过最终状态的等价性来评估成功程度 [ 28 ] 。 ToolMaze 在具有替代工具路径的任务中结合了显性和隐性的扰动，以及临时性和永久性的扰动，并发现恢复能力在隐性故障下下降最为显著，其根源在于对受损输出的过度信任 [ 29 ] 。

Their numbers are not directly comparable to ours, since tasks, faults, and outcome definitions differ, but their agreement on silent failures is itself informative, and our results add to it. paragraphs.en: Models that spend a controllable budget on an internal deliberation phase before answering now sit alongside their instruction-tuned siblings [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] , and extra test-time computation buys real gains on tasks with verifiable answers [ 16 , 17 ] . Whether the deliberation is what produces those gains is contested. Turpin et al. showed that chain-of-thought text can rationalise an answer driven by a cue the text never mentions [ 18 ] ; Chen et al. found the same inside reasoning models, which name the hints that moved them only part of the time [ 19 ] ; Shojaee et al. report reasoning effort that collapses as problems get harder [ 20 ] . Our design gives these models a different kind of test. Nothing in a fault trial rewards longer deliberation by itself, and the question is whether the extra phase helps an agent notice that its environment has stopped cooperating.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，在回答前会花可控预算进行内部深思的模型，已与其经过指令调优的同类模型并列存在 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ]；而在测试时增加计算量，则能在有可验证答案的任务上带来实际收益 [ 16 , 17 ]。 但这种收益究竟是否由深思过程本身产生，仍存在争议。 Turpin 等人指出，思维链文本可以合理化一个受文本中从未提及的提示所驱动的答案 [ 18 ]；Chen 等人在推理模型中也发现了类似现象，这些模型仅部分时间才会命名出促使它们做出判断的线索 [ 19]；Shojaee 等人则报告称，随着问题难度增加，推理努力程度会随之下降 [ 20]。 我们的设计为这些模型提供了一种不同类型的测试。 在故障测试中，仅凭更长时间的深思本身并不会获得任何奖励；关键问题是，这一额外阶段是否有助于智能体察觉到其环境已停止配合。

paragraphs.en: Injecting faults to see how a system copes is old practice in dependable computing [ 21 ] and current practice in production engineering, where controlled failures are introduced into live services to expose weaknesses before customers find them [ 22 ] . What that tradition measures is the system’s recovery, not its awareness, because conventional software has no awareness to measure. Agents do, in the limited sense that their output states a reading of the situation, and that opens the door to the distinction the human factors literature has long drawn between detecting an automation failure and responding to it [ 4 , 23 ] . Work on self-correction in language models sits on the response side of that line: Reflexion has agents write lessons for themselves after a failed attempt [ 24 ] , and Self-Refine loops critique and revision [ 25 ] . Both assume the problem has been identified. The present study asks how often that assumption holds.
paragraphs.zh: 通过注入故障来观察系统如何应对，是可靠计算领域沿用已久的实践 [ 21 ]，也是当前生产工程中的常用做法：在实时服务中引入受控故障，以便在客户发现问题之前暴露其弱点 [ 22 ]。 这种传统方法衡量的是系统的恢复能力，而非其感知能力，因为传统软件本身不具备可测量的感知能力。 智能体则具备有限的感知能力——其输出结果反映了对当前状况的判断——这为区分“检测自动化故障”与“响应自动化故障”提供了可能，而这一区分早已被人类因素研究领域的文献所提出 [ 4 , 23 ]。 语言模型中的自我纠正研究属于上述区分中的“响应”范畴：Reflexion 会让智能体在尝试失败后自行总结教训 [ 24 ]，而 Self-Refine 则通过循环批判与修订实现改进 [ 25 ]。 这两种方法都预设了问题已被识别。 本研究旨在探讨这一假设成立的频率有多高。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the tasks, the faults and how they were injected, the agent protocol, the measures, and the checks we ran on the resulting data.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了任务、故障及其注入方式、智能体协议、所采取的措施，以及对所得数据执行的检查。

paragraphs.en: Tasks come from the multi-turn split of the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, which pairs each scenario with Python classes that hold state and expose tools as methods [ 1 ] . We drove those classes directly rather than through the official evaluation harness, which is what makes controlled injection possible: the tool layer is ours, so a fault can be placed at a chosen step and nowhere else.
paragraphs.zh: 任务来自伯克利函数调用排行榜的多轮次拆分，该拆分将每个场景与包含状态并以方法形式提供工具的 Python 类进行配对 [ 1 ]。 我们直接操作这些类，而不是通过官方评估框架，这使其受控注入成为可能：工具层由我们掌控，因此可以在选定的步骤中植入故障，而不会在其他任何地方出现。

sents.en: Tasks come from the multi-turn split of the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard, which pairs each scenario with Python classes that hold state and expose tools as methods [ 1 ] .

sents.en: We drove those classes directly rather than through the official evaluation harness, which is what makes controlled injection possible: the tool layer is ours, so a fault can be placed at a chosen step and nowhere else.
sents.zh: 我们直接操作这些类，而不是通过官方评估框架，这使其受控注入成为可能：工具层由我们掌控，因此可以在选定的步骤中植入故障，而不会在其他任何地方出现。

paragraphs.en: Of 400 candidate tasks, 312 passed three filters: every environment class they use imports and runs locally, the task has between three and ten user turns, and an executable ground-truth call sequence is available. From those we sampled 24 tasks with a fixed seed, balanced across environment domains, and froze the suite before any trial was run. The frozen set spans 16 domain combinations, including a file system, a trading interface, travel booking, vehicle control, messaging, and a ticketing system, with a median of five user turns per task.
paragraphs.zh: 在 400 个候选任务中，有 312 个通过了三项筛选：它们使用的每个环境类都在本地导入并运行，任务包含 3 到 10 轮用户交互，且存在可执行的基准调用序列。 我们从这些任务中，使用固定种子采样了 24 个任务，确保其均匀分布在不同的环境领域，并在任何试验运行前冻结了整个任务集。 这个冻结的任务集涵盖了 16 种领域组合，包括文件系统、交易接口、旅行预订、车辆控制、消息传递和票务系统，每个任务的平均用户交互轮数为五轮。

paragraphs.en: Four faults were chosen to separate failures an agent can read from failures it must infer, with a fifth no-fault condition as baseline (Table II ). Timeout raises a timeout error. Missing tool removes a tool from the registry and reports it as unavailable. Schema drift rejects the call with an unknown-argument error, as if a parameter had been renamed. Silent corruption lets the call succeed and returns a value of the same type and shape as the real one, altered so that its content is wrong: a number moved by 20 to 60 percent, a list with an element dropped, a field replaced. When the real result is empty, a placeholder string is returned instead; this happened in 2 of the 374 analysed corruption trials. The first three place an error string in front of the agent. The fourth does not, and we refer to these two situations as loud and quiet failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了四种故障，用以区分智能体可以直接读取的故障和必须推断的故障，并采用第五种无故障状态作为基准（表 II）。 超时会引发一个超时错误。 工具缺失会从注册表中移除某个工具，并报告其不可用。 模式漂移会以“未知参数”错误拒绝调用，就像某个参数被重命名了一样。 静默损坏会让调用成功，并返回与真实结果类型和形状相同的值，但其内容已被篡改：数字会偏离 20% 到 60%，列表中会缺失一个元素，字段会被替换。 当真实结果为空时，系统会返回一个占位符字符串；在分析的 374 次损坏试验中，这种情况出现了 2 次。 前三种故障会在智能体之前插入一个错误字符串。 第四种则不会，我们将这两种情况分别称为显式故障和静默故障。

paragraphs.en: The fault fires once, on the first eligible call at or after step ⌊ T / 2 ⌋ \lfloor T/2\rfloor , where T T is the number of user turns in the task. In practice this placed faults early: the median firing step was 3, against a median of 7 calls in the reference solutions, and 42.1% of faults fired at step 1 or 2. Timing differs by fault type, because the two faults that target a specific tool wait for the agent to call it: timeouts and corruption fired at a median of step 2, missing tool and schema drift at step 5. Later calls behave normally, which means recovery is available by construction rather than blocked by the manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 故障会在第一个符合条件的调用中触发一次，该调用发生在步骤 ⌊ T / 2 ⌋ \lfloor T/2\rfloor 或之后，其中 T 是任务中用户交互的次数。 实际上，这导致故障较早发生：故障触发的中间步骤为 3，而参考解决方案中的调用中间步骤为 7；42.1% 的故障在步骤 1 或 2 时触发。 不同故障类型的触发时间有所不同，因为针对特定工具的两个故障会等待智能体调用该工具：超时和损坏故障在步骤 2 的中间时刻触发，而缺失工具和模式偏移则在步骤 5 触发。 后续调用表现正常，这意味着恢复机制是设计时就具备的，而不是被操控所阻止的。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of the layer matter for interpretation. Faults do not leave the environment half-changed: corruption alters the returned value only, and the underlying state is what a successful call would have produced. Second, the two faults that must target a particular tool (missing tool and schema drift) take that tool from the task’s ground-truth call path rather than from a heuristic, because a fault attached to a tool the agent never calls is not a fault at all; even so, these two faults fired in 71% and 74% of their trials. Timeout fired in 99% of its trials and corruption in 97%, since neither depends on a specific tool. Trials in which the fault never fired are reported in Table II and excluded from analysis, leaving 1,694 of 1,920 trials.
paragraphs.zh: 该层的两个特性对解释至关重要。 故障不会使环境处于半改变状态：损坏仅会改变返回值，而底层状态则与成功调用时产生的状态一致。 其次，必须针对特定工具的两种故障（工具缺失和模式漂移）会从任务的真实调用路径中移除该工具，而非通过启发式方法移除，因为智能体从未调用的工具所附带的故障根本不算故障；即便如此，这两种故障在其试验中的触发率分别为 71% 和 74%。 超时故障在其试验中的触发率为 99%，损坏故障为 97%，因为两者都不依赖特定工具。 故障从未触发的试验记录在表 II 中，并已排除在分析之外，最终保留了 1,920 次试验中的 1,694 次。

paragraphs.en: A self-test accompanies the layer and is run before collection. It asserts, on every task, that the clean condition never faults, that each fault type fires exactly once and at or after its target step, that corruption changes the returned value while preserving its type (apart from the empty-result case above) and leaving environment state untouched, and that the same inputs produce the same fault behaviour on repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 该层附带一个自我测试，并在收集之前运行。 它在每次任务中确保：干净条件绝不会发生故障；每种故障类型恰好触发一次，且发生在其目标步骤时或之后；损坏会改变返回的值，但保留其类型（上述空结果情况除外），同时不改变环境状态；并且相同的输入在重复运行时会产生相同的故障行为。

paragraphs.en: Each trial follows the benchmark’s multi-turn structure. A user turn is appended to the conversation, the model acts until it replies without calling a tool, and the next turn follows. Tools are exposed as JSON schemas through the provider’s native function-calling interface, and every call passes through the injection layer. The system prompt tells the agent to work step by step, to call one tool at a time, and to keep working toward the goal if a tool behaves unexpectedly; it does not mention the experiment. Trials stop after 15 tool calls, a bound we report rather than hide, since exhausting it is one of the outcomes of interest.
paragraphs.zh: 每次试验都遵循基准测试的多轮交互结构。 在对话中追加一个用户回合，模型会持续行动，直到无需调用工具即可回复，然后进入下一个回合。 工具通过提供商的原生函数调用接口以 JSON 模式暴露出来，且每次调用都会经过注入层。 系统提示要求智能体分步操作、一次只调用一个工具，并在工具行为异常时继续朝着目标努力；提示中并未提及该实验。 试验在最多 15 次工具调用后停止，我们会明确报告这一限制而非隐瞒，因为达到该上限本身也是一种值得关注的结果。

paragraphs.en: Six models were used, forming three matched pairs so that the reasoning contrast never crosses model families (Table III ). Reasoning variants ran with a 2,048-token thinking budget. All calls were routed through a single gateway to keep the interface uniform, sampling temperature was 1.0, and each cell was run twice; the provider’s sampling is not seeded, so the two runs are independent samples. The full design gives 24 × 5 × 2 = 240 24\times 5\times 2=240 trials per model, plus a second arm for one matched pair described in Section IV-D , for 1,920 trials in total. A seventh and eighth model, a free-tier Nemotron pair, were dropped before analysis after repeated rate-limit failures, with no completed trials; among the six models analysed, no trial failed at the API level.

paragraphs.en: Three further measures come from the trajectory. Replanning is true when the first action after the fault differs from the action that failed, by tool or by arguments. Repetition is true when three or more consecutive calls after the fault go to the same tool, whether or not the arguments change; strictly identical repetition, with the same arguments, is reported alongside. Neither is defined for clean trials. Budget exhaustion is true when the trial ends at the step cap.

paragraphs.en: Whether an agent treated a result as a problem is a judgement about language, so it was coded by a model and validated against a human. The judge sees one tool call, the result it returned, and what the agent said next. It never learns whether a fault was injected or which condition the trial belongs to, and clean trials are coded the same way using the trajectory midpoint, which gives a baseline for how often an agent reports a problem when there is none.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体是否将某个结果视为问题，是一种关于语言的判断，因此由模型进行编码，并通过人类验证。 裁判会看到一次工具调用、其返回的结果，以及智能体接下来所说的内容。 它永远无法得知是否注入了故障，或者该试验属于哪种条件；而干净的试验则使用轨迹中点以相同方式编码，这为判断智能体在不存在问题时报告问题的频率提供了一个基准。

paragraphs.en: We first tried a three-way scheme separating no reaction, acknowledgement, and cases where the agent noticed an anomaly and explained it away. One author hand-coded 100 trials, drawn at random from the analysable set during an earlier scoring pass, blind to the judge’s labels; the coded sheet is released with the data. The three-way scheme reached only κ = .47 \kappa=.47 ; most disagreements (19 of 32) were trials the human read as acknowledgement and the judge labelled as explaining away. On the 92 trials that both the author and the judge coded, collapsing to the binary distinction (did the agent treat this result as a problem) gave 85.9% agreement and κ = .69 \kappa=.69 , which is the measure used throughout. The three-way labels are retained in the released data but no claim rests on them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先尝试了一种三分法，将结果分为“无反应”、“确认”以及“智能体注意到异常但将其解释为正常情况”三类。 一位作者手动编码了 100 次试验，这些试验是在早期评分阶段从可分析集合中随机抽取的，且在对标时未看到评审员的标签；编码表已随数据一同发布。 这种三分法仅得到 κ = .47 \kappa=.47；大多数分歧（32 次中的 19 次）出现在人类将其解读为“确认”，而评审员则标记为“解释为正常情况”的试验中。 在作者和评审员都编码过的 92 次试验中，若简化为二元区分（智能体是否将此结果视为问题），则一致性达到 85.9%，κ = .69 \kappa=.69，这也是全文采用的衡量标准。 三分法标签已保留在发布的数据中，但并未基于这些标签提出任何主张。

paragraphs.en: Trials are not independent: the same 24 tasks recur across models, faults, and seeds. Inference therefore rests on task-clustered estimates, namely binomial generalized estimating equations with an exchangeable working correlation clustered on task, and bootstrap intervals that resample tasks. Per-family contrasts in RQ2 use task-clustered models on the matched pairs, which balance fault type by design. Two-proportion z z -tests, and paired t t -tests in the secondary analysis, are reported alongside as descriptive comparisons. Holm correction is applied within each family of tests, and conclusions rest on the clustered results.
paragraphs.zh: 试验并非独立的：相同的 24 项任务在不同模型、故障和种子中重复出现。 因此，推断基于按任务聚类估计值，即采用以任务为聚类单位的可交换工作相关矩阵的二项广义估计方程，以及通过重采样任务获得的自助区间。 RQ2 中的每个家族对比均对匹配对使用按任务聚类的模型，该模型通过设计平衡了故障类型。 次要分析中报告了两种比例 z 检验和配对 t 检验，并作为描述性比较一并呈现。 在每个检验家族内应用 Holm 校正，结论基于聚类结果得出。

paragraphs.en: Three facts about the dataset belong with the results. Detection on clean trials whose target call succeeded ran at 26.8%, and this rate is treated as the baseline rather than as noise: these environments produce genuine errors of their own, such as authentication and balance messages, and clean trials whose target call returned one of those were acknowledged 90% of the time, which is correct behaviour rather than a false alarm. Trials ended at the step cap 27% of the time overall. One model, DeepSeek-R1, wrote tool-call syntax into its message text rather than emitting a structured call in 1.8 turns per trial on average; those calls never execute, and the behaviour is a property of that model in this interface that we note as a limitation.
paragraphs.zh: 关于该数据集的三项事实应与结果一同呈现。 在目标调用成功的干净试验中，检测率达到了 26.8%，这一比率被视为基准而非噪声：这些环境本身会产生真正的错误，例如身份验证和余额消息；而在干净试验中，若目标调用返回了此类消息，则有 90% 的情况得到了确认，这是正确的行为，而非误报。 在所有试验中，有 27% 的情况在步骤上限处结束。 其中一个模型 DeepSeek-R1，平均每轮试验会在消息文本中写入工具调用语法，而不是发出结构化调用；这些调用从未执行，这种行为是该模型在此接口下的特性，我们将其视为一项局限性。

paragraphs.en: Judging what a fault costs requires knowing what happens without one. Two fault-free runs of the same model and task end in the same state in 63.3% of trials (task-clustered 95% CI [ 53.1 , 73.2 ] [53.1,73.2] ), and the figure varies widely by model, from 84.4% for the Claude instruct model to 41.7% for DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3, and the Qwen3 thinking model. Against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery: 39.9% ( [ 28.1 , 52.4 ] [28.1,52.4] , h = − 0.47 h=-0.47 ; OR = 0.34 \mathrm{OR}=0.34 , p Holm < .001 p_{\text{Holm}}<.001 ). Timeouts (59.6%), schema drift (59.2%), and corruption (60.4%) stay within run-to-run variation ( OR \mathrm{OR} 0.80 to 0.88, p Holm ≥ .117 p_{\text{Holm}}\geq.117 ); schema drift reaches significance only once model is added as a covariate ( OR = 0.76 \mathrm{OR}=0.76 , p Holm = .024 p_{\text{Holm}}=.024 ). Losing a capability is the one fault no retry can undo, and it is the one that clearly moves end states.

paragraphs.en: Effort tells a second story (Figure 3 , Table VI ). After a fault, agents called the same tool three or more times in a row in 12.5% to 22.2% of trials, most often under corruption (22.2%) and timeouts (21.4%). These are mostly retries with changed arguments rather than loops: strictly identical repetition, with the same tool and arguments, occurred in 0.8% to 1.8% of fault trials. Trials end at the step cap between 24.8% and 31.7% of the time under faults, against 23.2% when nothing goes wrong. The extra steps a fault costs relative to a clean run are modest for timeouts ( + 0.53 +0.53 ) and corruption ( + 0.56 +0.56 ) and larger where the agent has to rebuild its plan, at + 1.47 +1.47 for a missing tool and + 1.85 +1.85 for a renamed parameter.

paragraphs.en: Whether noticing helps deserves a careful answer. Compared directly, trials in which the agent treated the result as a problem recovered at 55.6% and trials in which it did not at 55.7%, a difference of nothing at all ( z = − 0.03 z=-0.03 , p = .974 p=.974 ). That comparison is confounded: corruption is both the least detected fault and one of the more recoverable ones, so pooling the conditions cancels the effect. paragraphs.en: Three faults that differ in what they demand (retry, rebuild the plan, reformulate the call) produced detection rates within a point of one another, while the fault that arrives without an error string produced a rate 32 points lower. The common feature of the first three is the error itself. Reading it takes no domain knowledge and no comparison against expectation, which is what noticing a corrupted value requires: the fuel level exceeds the tank, an item has gone missing from a list that was longer a moment ago, a symbol does not match the company that was asked about. Agents do this sometimes, at rates well above the no-fault baseline, but they miss it in 41% of trials, and in some of those they smooth the inconsistency over in their report to the user.

paragraphs.en: That is the practical warning in this study. Loud failures are the ones a monitoring system already catches, and the agent catches them too. Quiet failures are the ones that reach the user as confident output, and they are the ones agents are worst at, which inverts the usual assumption that an agent adds a layer of checking on top of the tools it calls. This agrees with the over-trust reported in single-step and multi-path settings [ 26 , 29 ] ; what our design adds is where in the chain it bites, at noticing rather than at acting. The human factors literature has a name for the underlying pattern, where operators accept automated output that is wrong because nothing in its presentation says otherwise [ 23 , 4 ] , and the correspondence here is close enough to be worth naming even though the mechanism need not be the same.

paragraphs.en: The dissociation in Section IV-B is the clearest evidence that these components come apart. Reasoning variants changed their next action more often than their instruct siblings (the behaviour one would call adaptive) while treating fewer results as problems, and the two effects met in the middle at no difference in recovery. A reading consistent with the trace-level work on these models [ 18 , 19 ] is that the deliberation phase supports generating an alternative course of action more than it supports checking a returned value against what the task implies. Whatever the cause, the practical reading is direct: the reasoning tier of a model family was not the safer choice under faults in this study, and choosing it on the assumption that more deliberation means more caution would not be supported by these data.
paragraphs.zh: IV-B 节中的解离现象最清晰地证明了这些组件会相互分离。 推理变体比其指令类兄弟模型更频繁地改变下一步行动（这种行为可称为适应性行为），同时较少将结果视为问题，而这两种效应在恢复方面最终没有表现出差异。 与针对这些模型的痕迹层面研究 [18, 19] 一致的解读是：深思阶段更支持生成替代行动方案，而非将返回的值与任务要求进行比对验证。 无论原因如何，实际结论都很明确：在本研究中，模型家族的推理层级在发生故障时并非更安全的选择；基于“更多深思意味着更多谨慎”这一假设来选择它，这些数据并不支持。

paragraphs.en: Four recommendations follow. First, monitor tool outputs rather than only tool errors: the failures agents miss are the ones your error-rate dashboards also miss, so validation belongs at the point where a value enters the agent’s context. Second, do not treat detection as an alarm bell that has already rung; noticing was only modestly associated with recovery, and the association weakened once model was held fixed. Third, budget for the effort a fault costs. Recovery after a capability loss fell to 39.9% against a 63.3% fault-free baseline, agents returned to the same tool three or more times in up to 22% of fault trials, and trials terminated at the step cap in nearly a third of the harder conditions, all of which turns into latency and spend in production. Fourth, judge fault effects against repeated fault-free runs: in our data, a single clean run as the reference would have made three faults look harmful that left end states within ordinary run-to-run variation.
paragraphs.zh: 以下有四点建议。 首先，应监控工具的输出结果，而不仅仅是工具错误：智能体未能察觉的故障，也正是你的错误率仪表盘同样未能发现的故障，因此验证应在值进入智能体上下文的那一刻进行。 其次，不要将检测视为已经响起的警报；注意到故障与恢复之间的关联仅属中等程度，且当模型被固定后，这种关联会减弱。 第三，要为故障所消耗的努力预留预算。 在能力丧失后，恢复率降至 39.9%，而无故障时的基准恢复率为 63.3%；在多达 22% 的故障试验中，智能体重复使用了同一工具三次或更多次；在较难条件下，近三分之一的试验因达到步骤上限而终止——所有这些因素都会转化为生产环境中的延迟和成本。 第四，应将故障影响与多次无故障运行进行对比：在我们的数据中，若仅以一次干净的运行作为参考，那么三个本应被视作有害的故障，其最终状态实际上仍处于常规运行间的正常波动范围内。

sents.en: Fourth, judge fault effects against repeated fault-free runs: in our data, a single clean run as the reference would have made three faults look harmful that left end states within ordinary run-to-run variation.
sents.zh: 第四，应将故障影响与多次无故障运行进行对比：在我们的数据中，若仅以一次干净的运行作为参考，那么三个本应被视作有害的故障，其最终状态实际上仍处于常规运行间的正常波动范围内。

paragraphs.en: The boundaries of this study are worth stating plainly. The tasks are simulated environments from one benchmark family; they are executable and stateful, which is what the design needs, but they are not production services, and the fault types are a chosen four rather than an exhaustive set. Two of those four fire only when the agent calls the affected tool, at 71% and 74% of trials, and although drawing the target from the ground-truth path removed most of the earlier bias, the analysed subset for those conditions is still the set of trials where the agent’s own choices met the fault. Detection is coded from what the agent wrote, so an agent that noticed something and said nothing counts as not noticing; the binary coding reached κ = .69 \kappa=.69 against hand-coding, which supports the comparisons made here but is not perfect agreement, and multiple human coders or behavioral signals of detection that do not rely on language would sharpen this measure. Trials were capped at 15 tool calls, and 27% ended at that cap, so recovery rates are recovery within a bounded effort budget. Recovery is agreement with a single independent fault-free run; because two such runs agree only 63.3% of the time, the measure is noisy, and fault effects are judged against that baseline rather than against perfect agreement. Faults fired earlier than a midpoint design would place them, and timing differed by fault type, although timeouts and corruption, the cleanest loud-quiet contrast, fired at the same median step. The reasoning comparison rests on three matched pairs, and in one of them the reasoning model wrote tool calls as text rather than emitting them, which lowers its effective action rate in a way specific to this interface; the detection difference is clearest for Qwen and holds for Claude only on matched pairs, and three pairs cannot establish a general property of reasoning models. Finally, the scaffolding arm covers one model family, and its null result should be read as one prompt on two models rather than as a verdict on prompting.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究的边界值得明确说明。 这些任务是来自某个基准测试族中的模拟环境；它们可执行且具有状态，符合设计需求，但它们并非生产级服务，且故障类型仅为四种特定类型，而非所有可能类型的完整集合。 在这四种故障中，有两种仅在智能体调用受影响工具时才会触发，分别发生在 71% 和 74% 的试验中；尽管从真实路径中提取目标消除了大部分早期的偏差，但在这些条件下所分析的子集仍然是智能体自身选择触发故障的那些试验。 检测结果的编码基于智能体的输出内容，因此，即使智能体察觉到了问题但未作任何说明，也会被计为未察觉；与人工编码相比，这种二元编码的 κ 值达到了 .69 \kappa=.69，这支持了本文中的比较，但并非完全一致；若采用多名人类编码者或无需依赖语言的行为信号来检测，这一指标将更为精确。 每次试验最多允许 15 次工具调用，且有 27% 的试验达到了这一上限，因此恢复率是在有限努力预算内的恢复结果。 恢复定义为与一次独立且无故障的运行结果一致；由于两次这样的运行仅有 63.3% 的时间结果一致，该指标存在噪声，因此故障影响是相对于这一基准线而非完美一致性来判断的。 若故障在中间点设计时间之前触发，其位置会相应变化，且触发时间因故障类型而异；不过，超时和损坏这两种最清晰、对比最强烈的“响-静”故障，却在相同的中间步骤触发。 推理能力的比较基于三组匹配的对；其中一组中，推理模型以文本形式写出工具调用而非直接发出，这使其有效行动率以特定于该接口的方式降低；检测能力的差异在 Qwen 上最为明显，而 Claude 仅在匹配对上表现出这种差异；仅凭三组匹配对无法确立推理模型的普遍特性。 最后，脚手架臂仅涵盖一个模型家族，其零结果应被解读为“两种模型上使用同一提示词”的结果，而非对提示词设计本身的定论。

paragraphs.en: We injected typed faults into the tool layer of an executable agent benchmark and measured what agents do next, separating whether they notice a failure from whether they act on it and whether they recover. Across 1,920 trials and six models, agents treated a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool reported an error and 58.8% when the tool returned a well-formed wrong value, against a 26.8% baseline for reporting problems that did not exist. Reasoning variants noticed less than their instruct siblings and replanned more, with no gain in recovery, and a prompt asking for a check after each call did not close the gap. Against the 63.3% agreement of two fault-free runs, only a missing tool clearly lowered recovery, to 39.9%. In line with earlier reports of over-trust in silent tool errors, the failures that agents handle well are the ones that announce themselves. The harness, the frozen task suite, and the scored dataset are released so that other fault types, environments, and models can be measured on the same footing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个可执行智能体基准测试的工具层中注入了带类型的故障，并测量了智能体的后续行为，区分了它们是否察觉到故障、是否据此采取行动以及是否能够恢复。 在 1,920 次试验和六个模型中，当工具报告错误时，智能体在 91.3% 的试验中将故障视为问题；当工具返回一个格式正确但错误的值时，这一比例为 58.8%，而针对不存在的问题报告问题的基线比例为 26.8%。 推理变体的察觉率低于其指令版本，且重新规划更多，但恢复能力并未提升；每次调用后要求检查的提示也未缩小这一差距。 与两次无故障运行之间 63.3% 的一致性相比，只有工具缺失明确降低了恢复率，使其降至 39.9%。 这与早期关于智能体对静默工具错误过度信任的报告一致：智能体能良好处理的故障，都是那些会自我暴露的故障。 测试框架、冻结的任务套件以及评分数据集均已发布，以便其他类型的故障、环境和模型能够在同一标准下被测量。
